# Barney Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c13 P2](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0002), [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

He is a large, overweight twenty-year-old youth with a round face completely devoid of expression.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

He is emotionless, quiet, and suffers from an agonizing inability to hold a conversation, though he is capable of quiet admiration and pride. He is also extremely shy and easily intimidated by social situations, fleeing out of sheer dread at the prospect of being invited to a formal supper.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_

## Traits

- Large and overweight  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Emotionless  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Incapable of holding conversation  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Shy and easily intimidated  <sub>[v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Driving a double-seated buggy and team  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)</sub>

## History

In August, Barney drove his double-seated buggy carrying his sister Odette, Nell Harcourt, and Isolde Pembroke to a fundraising concert at the Pale Sands Hotel. He insisted on having Nell sit beside him on the front seat, feeling immense pride in her company despite his inability to converse. During the journey, he mostly smirked and laughed softly without being able to form verbal replies. Upon arriving at the hotel, he hid away and fled out of sheer dread at the prospect of being invited to supper with the performers and guests, though he waited outside with the team to drive the girls safely home after the event concluded.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039)_
